title: The Starting the Song After the Rest
youtube_title: The Starting the Song After the Rest | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Speaking up once, softly, can open a door.
summary: At a music corner with a drum and a recorder, Ines feels shy about starting a song after a rest, when the room was listening. Instead of pretending not to care, Ines tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie Luz stays kind and does not push for a show.
